computers.title: This phone uses
computers.footer: When the one you pick is out of reach, this phone uses another computer of the group and switches back once it answers again.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.footer: Changes apply to your computer right away. Running chats pick them up with their next message.

language.title: Language
language.detail: System follows this phone's language. The same on your computer.

mode.title: Interface
mode.easyBlurb: Plain words and only what you need day to day. Everything else is one click away.
mode.proBlurb: Every tool, setting and detail in view: models, runs, machines, logs.

links.instructionsDetail: Rules for every agent, workspace and project

privacy.title: Data & privacy
privacy.footer: Logins, 2FA codes, backups and the rest of Security stay on your computer.
privacy.faceIdDetail: Hides Godmode in the app switcher and asks after 30 seconds away.

app.title: App
app.footer: Remove this phone on your computer anytime in Settings → Phone.

palette.title: Palette
palette.detail: Just for this phone, light and dark.

paper.label: Paper
paper.blurb: Warm paper by day, anthracite by night

graphite.label: Graphite
graphite.blurb: Cool neutral greys with a blue accent

solarized.label: Solarized
solarized.blurb: Ethan Schoonover's classic cream and teal

rose.label: Rosé
rose.blurb: Soft blush with a raspberry accent

dracula.label: Dracula
dracula.blurb: Purple night, and a pale day to match

suggestions.title: Show suggestions
suggestions.detail: Ideas like “Summarize my unread emails” on Home and in a new chat.

defaultModel.title: Default model
defaultModel.footer: Agents without a model of their own use this one. Change it per agent, or per chat from the composer.
defaultModel.effortDetail: How long Claude thinks before it acts.
defaultModel.fallbackDetail: Used when the default model is overloaded.

work.title: Work
work.footer: Runs over the limit wait in line. A run that takes longer than the timeout is stopped.
work.continueLimitDetail: A run that hit Claude's limit picks up by itself once it resets.
work.resumeDetail: Work cut off by a restart, a lost internet connection or the end of a turn picks up by itself once Godmode and the connection are back.

compact.title: Long chats
compact.footer: A chat that fills this much of the model's memory is summarized by itself and goes on from the summary. Earlier keeps every step faster and cheaper, later keeps more detail. Compress any chat by hand with the ring next to the model.

watchdog.title: Watchdog
watchdog.footer: Stops runs that stall or go in circles, so they don't burn time and tokens.

browser.title: Browser
browser.footer: Agents browse in their own profiles, with your saved logins filled in by Godmode.
browser.headlessDetail: No browser window opens on your computer.
browser.stealthDetail: Hides automation signals so sites don't block agents.
browser.liveViewDetail: Watch the browser while an agent works.

computer.title: Computer use
computer.footer: Agents only see and control a screen, window or tab you share with them in a chat.
computer.foregroundDetail: Briefly, when a background action doesn't land.

vm.title: Virtual machines
vm.footer: Agents with a VM work inside it instead of on this computer.

instructions.intro: Rules your agents follow on every run. Set them once for everyone, then refine them per workspace, project or agent.
instructions.precedence: All of them go into every run. When two disagree, the more specific one wins.
instructions.example:
1. Commit as me only, never add an AI co-author.
2. Keep code comments to a minimum.
3. Merge main into your branch before opening a pull request.
4. For UI changes, attach screenshots.

workspaces.title: Workspaces and projects
workspaces.footer: Agent context: given to every agent working in the workspace or project.
workspaces.createDetail: Give a client or product its own agents and context.

agents.footer: Each agent's own role and standing orders.

instructions.tip: Just one chat? Write it into the chat. It only applies there and wins over everything above.

memory.footer: Each agent keeps what it learns in its own repository on your computer.
memory.injectDetail: Loads the agent's memory into each new chat.
memory.reflectDetail: Agents note what they learned when a run ends.

dreaming.title: Dreaming
dreaming.footer: While idle, agents review recent chats and tidy up their memory and workspace: merge duplicates, fix contradictions, date what has passed, sort files — and keep the memory short enough to load into every chat.
dreaming.tidyDetail: Sorts files into folders and clears out leftovers.
dreaming.offers: Offer to take work off your plate
dreaming.offersDetail: Your main agent offers work it spotted on Home.

upkeep.title: Upkeep
upkeep.footer: Godmode looks after itself: repairs, updates of its tools, and cleaning up old files.

notFound.title: Agent not found
notFound.body: It may have been deleted on your computer.

agent.activeOff: Does nothing until you switch it on.
agent.instructionsPlaceholder:
What it does, how, and when it asks you.
For example: Check my inbox every morning and draft replies to customers.
agent.descriptionPlaceholder: One or two lines your other agents see when they hand work over.
agent.memoryFooter: What the agent learned and keeps loading into every chat. It updates this itself; your edits guide what it remembers.

thinking.title: Thinking
thinking.footer: Default follows AI & Claude in Settings.

heartbeat.footer: Wakes up on its own to move its tickets forward and work through its checklist.
heartbeat.checklistPlaceholder:
Standing duties for every beat.
For example: Check Stripe for unpaid orders.

workspaces.footer: A workspace gives a client or product its own agents, context, repositories and projects.

none.title: No workspaces yet
none.body: Give a client or product its own agents, context and repositories.

workspace.title: Workspace

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.body: Its repositories and context go with it. This can't be undone.

workspace.notEmpty: {{name}} still has projects, agents, tasks, logins or other things in it. Move or delete them first, or delete the workspace on your computer.
workspace.contextPlaceholder:
Who the client is, what the product does, links, tone, rules.
Every agent in this workspace gets it on every run.
workspace.projectsFooter: Projects add their own context and repositories on top of the workspace's.
workspace.sourcesFooter: Every agent in the workspace works with these. Tasks get their own branch of a repository. Add folders of your computer there.
workspace.autoMergeDetail: A ticket is done when its agent delivers, without your review.
workspace.deleteFooter: Only an empty workspace can be deleted here: no projects, agents, tasks or logins. Its chats move to every workspace.

project.deleteBody: Its context and repositories go with it. Chats, tickets and agents stay in the workspace.
project.contextPlaceholder:
Goals, scope, conventions and links for this project.
Added to the workspace's context on every run.
project.agentsFooter: Agents work on this project by default. Chats and tickets can pick another.
project.sourcesFooter: On top of the workspace's. Add folders of your computer there.

new.anyWorkspace: It can work in any workspace you start it in.
new.routineHint: Its automation “{{name}}” ({{schedule}}) can be added on your computer.
new.setupHint: Logins, tools and folders for new agents are set on your computer.
